content.definition: Accounting procedure allowing company with deficit in retained earnings to restate its accounts and create 'fresh start' without legal reorganization
content.purpose: Eliminate accumulated deficit in retained earnings to allow future dividend payments and improve financial presentation
content.when_used: Company has accumulated losses (deficit RE) but is now profitable and expects continued profitability
requirements: Deficit eliminated against additional paid-in capital
Date of quasi-reorganization disclosed for 10 years

steps.step_1: Revalue assets and liabilities to FAIR VALUE. Adjust retained earnings for gains/losses.
steps.step_2: Eliminate deficit in retained earnings by reducing additional paid-in capital (or other contributed capital accounts)
steps.step_3: Date retained earnings to show 'fresh start' (e.g., 'Retained Earnings since quasi-reorganization of Jan 1, 20X1')

accounting_entries.revaluation: Write down overvalued assets, write up undervalued assets. Net adjustment to retained earnings.
accounting_entries.eliminate_deficit: DR Additional Paid-In Capital, CR Retained Earnings (to eliminate deficit)

calculation_example.facts: Company has: Assets (BV $500K, FV $450K), Liabilities (BV $300K, FV $300K), Common stock $100K, APIC $150K, Retained earnings $(50K) deficit. Total equity $200K.

step_2_eliminate_deficit.entry: DR Additional Paid-In Capital $100K, CR Retained Earnings $100K

calculation_example.balance_sheet_after: Assets $450K, Liabilities $300K, Equity: CS $100K + APIC $50K + RE $0 = $150K. Total equity reduced by $50K write-down.

content.disclosure: Date of quasi-reorganization must be disclosed in retained earnings for 10 years following reorganization

comparison_to_bankruptcy.legal_reorganization: Court-supervised bankruptcy (Chapter 11). Fresh start accounting if meets criteria.
comparison_to_bankruptcy.quasi_reorganization: Voluntary accounting procedure without court involvement. No discharge of debt.

fresh_start_accounting.bankruptcy_context: Similar concept applied in bankruptcy reorganization. Company revalues assets/liabilities, eliminates retained earnings.
fresh_start_accounting.difference: Bankruptcy fresh start also may result in new basis for assets beyond FV adjustments

content.limitations: Cannot be used repeatedly. Intended as one-time fresh start. Requires shareholder approval and full disclosure.
cpa_exam_tips: Quasi-reorganization eliminates deficit in retained earnings without legal reorganization
Step 1: Revalue assets/liabilities to FV, adjust RE for net change
Step 2: Eliminate deficit by reducing APIC
Disclose date of quasi-reorganization for 10 years
Total equity reduced by net write-downs (not a free pass - real economic impact)

key_points: Quasi-reorganization: Eliminate deficit in RE without legal reorganization
Step 1: Adjust assets/liabilities to FV, impact to RE
Step 2: Eliminate deficit by reducing APIC
Disclose date for 10 years in RE presentation
Total equity reduced by net asset write-downs
